findings.text: this test stubs _persist_forward on the fit module's namespace (tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py:115-116), but commit 05881adda repointed tests/test_magnetics_fit_efit_comparison.py:833 to resolve it from tests.magnetics_fit_harness, so the stub no longer reaches comparison._attempt and the test passes only because the real pickle write into the tmp output succeeds; the comment at lines 20-21 claiming the comparison module resolves helpers through this module's namespace is likewise now false, so the isolation this test intends is silently gone and the re-export at line 23 exists only for an inert patch.

item_verdicts.diff: read be5ee98f..ad6a93b65 commit by commit, centring on the five commits gained since the prior review (e0a832f5f, 05881adda, fd56bd24a, 0830bc3ac, ad6a93b65); the helper bodies and the four known-state test functions are byte-identical moves, the two prototype scripts and the comparison test are repointed to tests.magnetics_fit_harness, and the fragment's figure attributions are corrected to the revisions their logs name.
item_verdicts.done_when: read all three clauses; (1) the evidence fragment names test_known_state_recovery and its native site under libjax_common.so, with the abort condition reproduced (one Solovev case passes at both cache settings, 3266.66 s and 3245.69 s); (2) logs/head-serial.log and logs/head-n8.log each carry a pytest summary line and a bare EXIT=0 at fd56bd24a; (3) the moved test and helper definitions are byte-identical by AST comparison, with every slow and timeout(3500) decorator preserved and no assertion changed.
item_verdicts.goal: read the node goal and done_when against head ad6a93b65; the four known-state cases are split into a new module so a named-path measurement of tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py collects 44 unit tests, which logs/head-serial.log and logs/head-n8.log record passing in 6.46 s and 10.32 s with EXIT=0, and the prior review's blocking AttributeError in the two prototype scripts is repaired (scripts/prototypes/fit_inside_iteration/run.py:74,112,216 and scripts/prototypes/drifting_sensor_sequences/probe_rows/study.py:156 now import tests.magnetics_fit_harness directly).
item_verdicts.manifest: read the manifest; it names the eight commits and the fit-module-only gate command with logs/head-serial.log and logs/head-n8.log, records baseline_suite completed=false (exit 3, job 1338431 cancelled at its time limit) and after_suite completed=false (exit 3, job 1338451 cancelled because its command names both modules), and records the negative control honestly.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the eight declared paths against the seven-path diff be5ee98f..ad6a93b65; all seven changed paths lie inside the declared set and nothing outside it is touched.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion of its own: the known-states module is a byte-identical move of the four case functions and the harness is a byte-identical move of the helper bodies, so nothing fails if the split regresses, and one relinked call site (tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py:115) silently kept a now-inert stub.
justifications.evidence: logs/head-serial.log carries 44 passed in 6.46s and a bare EXIT=0 at fd56bd24a, logs/head-n8.log 44 passed in 10.32s with EXIT=0, and the fragment now attributes the be5ee98f measurements (5.00 s / 10.47 s) and the b4a9a31ff arms (4.68 s / 4.75 s) to their own revisions, repairing the prior review's attribution finding; the gate ran at fd56bd24a, a docs-only pair of commits before ad6a93b65.
justifications.fit: both new modules follow the surrounding test idiom (a module docstring and eager helper imports, as tests/sheet_fixtures.py does) and carry no version or plan label, but tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py:20-21 keeps a comment claiming the comparison module resolves helpers through this namespace, which commit 05881adda made false.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_equilibrium_magnetics_fit.py at head collects 44 unit tests that pass in 6.46 s and 10.32 s (logs/head-serial.log, logs/head-n8.log), and the prior review's broken re-export is repaired at scripts/prototypes/fit_inside_iteration/run.py:74.
justifications.reuse: a search of nova/, tests/ and scripts/ for receipt-persistence, diagnostic-source and known-state case-table capabilities found only the fit module itself, so tests/magnetics_fit_harness.py is the sole owner and no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the be5ee98f..ad6a93b65 diff lies inside the declared write paths, the declared figures directory stays untouched and no nova/ library file changes.
